messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Yeah, listen, I need to return a speaker I bought because it’s overpriced and it can’t even handle a splash of water. Also, I want to change the 17-inch laptop in another order to a 13-inch one instead. Don’t waste my time—just tell me what I need to do.

I can help, but I first need to authenticate your account.

1) What’s your **email address** (the one used for the order)?  
   - Alternatively, tell me your **first name + last name + zip code**.

Once I verify you, I’ll need:
2) For the **speaker return**: your **order id** (e.g., `#W0000000`) and which **speaker item(s)** you want to return (item name/quantity is fine to start).
3) For the **laptop change** (17-inch → 13-inch): your **other order id** and confirmation that you want to **replace the laptop item** (not cancel the order). If you know it, tell me the current 17-inch item option (and what 13-inch option you want, if applicable).

After that, I’ll check the order statuses (returns require **delivered**; item changes require **pending**) and then I’ll ask you to confirm the exact action details before anything is submitted.

Ugh, fine. The email is aarav.santos8321@example.com. 

For the speaker, I don’t have the order ID in front of me—can’t you just look it up by my email? It’s the more expensive speaker, and I only bought one. 

As for the laptop, yes, I want to swap the 17-inch for a 13-inch, not cancel the whole order. Again, just check my orders and tell me what 13-inch options you have, especially if there’s an i5 in silver or black. Don’t make me repeat myself.

I tried looking up your account by email (`aarav.santos8321@example.com`), but I couldn’t find a matching user record.

Please reply with **one** of the following so I can authenticate you:
1) Your **first name + last name + zip code**, or  
2) Another **email address** you might have used.

Once I authenticate you, I can:
- Look up the **delivered** order for the **more expensive speaker** and confirm the exact **item id** to return (you still won’t need to “repeat” much—just confirm which one).
- Check the other order that contains the **17-inch laptop** and confirm the available **13-inch** replacement options (including whether there’s an **i5 in silver or black**) before we submit any change.
Are you kidding me? It’s Aarav Santos, and the other email is aarav.santos8320@example.com. Just use that and get on with it. I don’t have all day.
